crossRefs.note: and for the drink offering you shall offer the third part of a hin of wine, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

parallels.note: The meal offering with it shall be two tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil, an offering made by fire to…

translations.web: and for the drink offering you shall offer the third part of a hin of wine, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.
translations.bsb: and a third of a hin of wine as a drink offering, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.
translations.kjv: And for a drink offering thou shalt offer the third part of an hin of wine, for a sweet savour unto the LORD.
translations.asv: and for the drink-offering thou shalt offer the third part of a hin of wine, of a sweet savor unto Jehovah.
